summary.en: US futures dipped 0.2% as Trump rejected Iran's peace proposal, keeping geopolitical risk elevated. Strong April jobs report (115K vs 62K consensus) reinforced higher-for-longer rates. AI momentum remains intact with semiconductor giants leading, while oil fluctuates near $100/bbl and gold slips on inflation fears.
summary.zh: 美股期货下跌 0.2%，因特朗普拒绝伊朗和平提议，地缘政治风险高企。强劲的 4 月就业报告（11.5 万 vs 6.2 万共识）强化了更高更持久的利率预期。AI 势头依然强劲，半导体巨头领先，油价徘徊在每桶 100 美元附近，黄金因通胀担忧下滑。

title.en: Trump Rejects Iran Peace Proposal - Geopolitical Risk Premiums Elevated
title.zh: 特朗普拒绝伊朗和平提议 - 地缘政治风险溢价高企

impact.en: Market uncertainty rises as hopes for US-Iran diplomatic breakthrough dimmed. Energy and defense sectors retain risk bid while ceasefire holds prevent major oil spike.
impact.zh: 美伊外交突破希望渺茫，市场不确定性上升。能源和国防板块保持风险买入，停火维持阻止油价大幅飙升。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Geopolitical risk in Middle East affecting energy prices
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 中东地缘政治风险影响能源价格

title.en: Strong Jobs Report Reinforces Higher-for-Longer Rates
title.zh: 强劲就业报告强化更高更持久利率预期

impact.en: April jobs data (115K actual vs 62K consensus) reduces Fed rate cut expectations for 2026, supporting elevated Treasury yields.
impact.zh: 4 月就业数据（实际 11.5 万 vs 共识 6.2 万）降低 2026 年美联储降息预期，支撑高企的美债收益率。

macroRisk.en: No - Bond market pressure from stronger employment data
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 强劲就业数据给债市带来压力

title.en: AI Rally Expands Beyond Tech with Industrial AI Initiative
title.zh: AI 上涨扩展到科技之外：工业 AI 倡议

impact.en: Apple-Intel chip pact and Jeff Bezos's $10B industrial AI fund signal broadening AI capex beyond traditional tech giants.
impact.zh: 苹果 - 英特尔芯片协议和贝佐斯 100 亿美元工业 AI 基金表明 AI 资本开支正扩展到传统科技巨头之外。

macroRisk.zh: 否 - 积极的工业 AI 发展

title.en: Gold Falls 1% on Oil-Driven Inflation Fears
title.zh: 黄金因油价推动的通胀担忧下跌 1%

impact.en: Elevated oil prices near $100/bbl fuel inflation concerns, reducing gold appeal as investors favor real yields over safe-haven metals.
impact.zh: 接近每桶 100 美元的高油价加剧通胀担忧，投资者偏好实际收益率而非避险金属，降低黄金吸引力。

macroRisk.en: No - Inflation dynamics driving precious metals
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 通胀动态推动贵金属走势

title.en: China Yuan Strengthens Ahead of Trump-Xi Summit
title.zh: 特朗普 - 习近平峰会前人民币走强

impact.en: PBOC's currency management keeps yuan at 3-year highs, setting stage for May 14-15 Beijing summit between US and Chinese leaders.
impact.zh: 中国人民银行的外汇管理使人民币维持在 3 年高点，为 5 月 14-15 日美中领导人北京峰会创造条件。

SPX.en: S&P 500 recorded weekly gains despite Asian session dip amid geopolitical concerns.
SPX.zh: 尽管地缘政治担忧下亚洲交易时段下跌，标普 500 仍录得周收益。

IXIC.en: Nasdaq 100 futures slightly higher despite resistance at 29,505/615 levels.
IXIC.zh: 纳指 100 期货小幅走高，尽管面临 29,505/615 水平阻力。

DJI.en: Dow Jones futures little changed, maintaining stability post-weekly gains.
DJI.zh: 道琼斯期货基本持平，在周收益后保持稳定。

10Y.en: 10-year Treasury yield supported near 4.45% amid 'higher-for-longer' rate expectations.
10Y.zh: 10 年期美债收益率在更高更持久利率预期支撑下维持在 4.45% 附近。

oil.en: Crude oil fluctuating near $100/bbl with upside risk from Middle East tensions.
oil.zh: 原油徘徊在每桶 100 美元附近，因中东紧张局势存在上涨风险。

gold.en: Gold slipped on inflation fears, holding below $4,775/oz 50-day moving average.
gold.zh: 黄金因通胀担忧下滑，保持在 4,775 美元/盎司 50 日均线下方。

technology.en: Broad tech strength despite market wobble. AI capex expansion supports large tech names as Apple-Intel pact signals industrial AI adoption.
technology.zh: 尽管市场波动，科技板块依然强劲。AI 资本开支扩张支撑大型科技股，苹果 - 英特尔协议表明工业 AI 正在采用。

energy.en: Energy sector retains risk bid despite ceasefire holding. Citi warns upward bias persists from geopolitical risk premiums.
energy.zh: 尽管停火维持，能源板块仍保持风险买入。花旗银行警告地缘政治风险溢价使向上倾向持续。

futures.en: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures dipped 0.2% as Trump rejected Iran peace deal. Dow Jones futures little changed. Mixed sentiment post-weekly gains.
futures.zh: 特朗普拒绝伊朗和平协议，标普 500 和纳指 100 期货下跌 0.2%。道琼斯期货基本持平。周收益后情绪混杂。

treasury10Y.en: 30-year Treasury yield supported at 4.90% (50-day MA) due to strong jobs data. Bond market under pressure from 'higher-for-longer' rate narrative.
treasury10Y.zh: 强劲就业数据支撑 30 年期美债收益率在 4.90%（50 日均线）。债市受更高更持久利率叙事压力。

keyRisk.en: US-Iran diplomatic developments - Trump's 'unacceptable' designation keeps geopolitical risk premium elevated even as military engagements pause.
keyRisk.zh: 美伊外交进展 - 特朗普的'不可接受' designation 使地缘政治风险溢价高企，即使军事行动暂停。

note.en: AI momentum and tech strength offset geopolitical headwinds from US-Iran tensions. Bond yields remain elevated post-strong jobs data. Oil's upward bias limits gold appeal. Favor selective positioning in AI leaders and energy, cautious on financials amid rate uncertainty.
note.zh: AI 势头和科技实力抵消美伊紧张局势带来的地缘政治逆风。强劲就业数据后债券收益率维持高企。油价向上倾向限制黄金吸引力。 favor 在 AI 领军股和能源板块选择性建仓，对金融板块保持谨慎，因利率不确定性。
